sections.heading: Why Choose an Underground Storm Shelter?
sections.html:
Why Choose an Underground Storm Shelter?

Underground storm shelters offer unparalleled protection from tornadoes, severe winds, and hail. By placing the shelter below ground, you gain a significant advantage against the powerful forces of a storm, including direct impacts and projectile debris.

These shelters are designed to be an integral part of your property, providing a secure refuge that is always ready. Their subterranean placement means they are less susceptible to above-ground structural damage, offering a robust and reliable safe zone for your family.

sections.heading: Durable Underground Storm Shelter Options
sections.html:
Durable Underground Storm Shelter Options

Texoma Storm Shelters provides two primary types of underground shelters: reinforced concrete and durable fiberglass. Both options offer exceptional strength and longevity, engineered to protect against severe weather.

  • Reinforced Concrete Shelters: These shelters are incredibly strong, offering superior impact resistance and fire protection. They are a popular choice for their robust construction and proven durability.
  • Fiberglass Shelters: Lightweight yet incredibly strong, fiberglass shelters are resistant to rust and corrosion, making them an excellent choice for longevity. They often feature a smooth interior for comfort.

We offer both slope-front and flat-top models to accommodate different preferences and yard layouts. Slope-front shelters feature an angled entry for easier access, while flat-top designs can be more discreetly integrated into your landscape.

sections.heading: Professional Installation & Water Table Protection
sections.html:
Professional Installation & Water Table Protection

The proper installation of an underground storm shelter is critical for its effectiveness and safety. Our licensed and insured team handles every step of the process, from initial site assessment and excavation to final placement and backfilling. We ensure your shelter is installed correctly, securely anchored, and properly sealed against the elements.

For properties in areas with high water tables, we implement specialized techniques to prevent leaks and ensure your shelter remains dry and safe. This includes using appropriate sealing materials and drainage strategies during installation, giving you confidence in your shelter's integrity.

We prioritize transparent communication throughout the installation, providing free written estimates so you know exactly what to expect. Our goal is to deliver a reliable, long-lasting storm shelter solution for your home in Sherman and across North Texas.

sections.heading: FEMA P-320 & ICC-500 Standards for North Texas
sections.html:
FEMA P-320 & ICC-500 Standards for North Texas

At Texoma Storm Shelters, your safety is our top priority. All our underground storm shelters are designed and installed to meet or exceed the rigorous standards set by FEMA P-320 (Taking Shelter From the Storm: Building a Safe Room Inside Your Home) and ICC-500 (Standard for the Design and Construction of Storm Shelters).

These guidelines ensure that your shelter provides the maximum possible protection against extreme wind events, including EF5 tornadoes. We are committed to bringing this critical level of safety to homes throughout Sherman, Denison, Pottsboro, Whitesboro, Van Alstyne, Gunter, and the wider Texoma region.

Don't wait for the next storm season to secure your family's safety. Contact Texoma Storm Shelters today at (903) 884-7210 for a free written estimate on an underground storm shelter. We're here to help you make an informed decision and provide a practical, reassuring solution.

faq.q: How much do underground storm shelters cost in Sherman TX?
faq.a: The cost for an installed underground storm shelter in Sherman TX typically ranges from $5,200 to $8,800. This price includes the shelter unit, excavation, and professional installation by our licensed and insured team. For more detailed pricing information and factors influencing the cost, visit our storm shelter cost page.

faq.q: How long does it take to install an underground storm shelter?
faq.a: Most underground storm shelter installations are completed within a single day. This includes the excavation, placement of the shelter, and backfilling. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption to your property while ensuring a secure and proper installation.

faq.q: What kind of maintenance do underground storm shelters require?
faq.a: Underground storm shelters require minimal maintenance. We recommend checking the door seals and hinges annually to ensure they operate smoothly and maintain a watertight seal. Keeping the entrance clear of debris is also important for quick access when needed.

faq.q: Can underground shelters be installed in areas with high water tables?
faq.a: Yes, we have specialized techniques and materials to install underground shelters safely and effectively in areas with high water tables. Our installation process includes measures to prevent leaks and ensure the shelter remains dry, providing reliable protection even in challenging soil conditions.

faq.q: Are there any rebates or financing options available for storm shelters?
faq.a: While Texoma Storm Shelters does not offer direct financing, we can guide you on potential local, state, or federal rebate programs that might be available for storm shelter installations. We recommend checking with your county emergency management office or local government for current programs, such as those sometimes offered through FEMA's Hazard Mitigation Grant Program.
